<script>
/* Home-page game search: pulls the live card list from games/index.html
   (rendered from raw/games/index.qmd), so new games appear here automatically. */
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('home-game-search'), grid = document.getElementById('home-games-grid'),
      countEl = document.getElementById('home-game-count');
  if (!input || !grid) return;
  var original = grid.innerHTML, cards = null, loading = null;
  function load() {
    if (cards) return Promise.resolve(cards);
    if (!loading) loading = fetch('games/index.html').then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
      return r.text();
    }).then(function (html) {
      var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
      cards = [].slice.call(doc.querySelectorAll('#game-grid a.sm-card')).map(function (a) {
        var c = document.importNode(a, true);
        c.setAttribute('href', 'games/' + a.getAttribute('href'));
        c.removeAttribute('hidden');
        return c;
      });
      return cards;
    });
    return loading;
  }
  function run() {
    var q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (!q.length) { grid.innerHTML = original; countEl.textContent = ''; return; }
    load().then(function (all) {
      if (input.value.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).join(' ') !== q.join(' ')) return;
      var hits = all.filter(function (c) {
        var hay = (c.textContent + ' ' + (c.dataset.tags || '')).toLowerCase();
        return q.every(function (w) { return hay.indexOf(w) >= 0; });
      });
      grid.innerHTML = '';
      hits.forEach(function (c) { grid.appendChild(c.cloneNode(true)); });
      countEl.textContent = hits.length ? hits.length + ' of ' + all.length + ' games' : 'No games match \u2014 try another word.';
    }).catch(function () { countEl.textContent = 'Could not load the games list. Try the full Games page.'; });
  }
  input.addEventListener('focus', load, { once: true });
  input.addEventListener('input', run);
  input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') { input.value = ''; run(); } });
})();
</script>

<script src="starfield.js"></script>

<script>
(function(){
  // ---- Typewriter subtitle ----
  var typedEl = document.getElementById('sm-typed-text');
  if (typedEl) {
    var phrases = [
      'Interactive lectures, tools, and games for learning statistics and data science.',
      'From probability basics to regression, all free and open.',
      'Build charts, run simulations, and master core concepts.',
      'Plus a blog on stats theory, R & Python, and dev tips.'
    ];
    var pi = 0, ci = 0, deleting = false;

    function tick(){
      var current = phrases[pi];
      if (!deleting) {
        ci++;
        typedEl.textContent = current.slice(0, ci);
        if (ci === current.length) {
          deleting = true;
          setTimeout(tick, 1800);
          return;
        }
      } else {
        ci--;
        typedEl.textContent = current.slice(0, ci);
        if (ci === 0) {
          deleting = false;
          pi = (pi + 1) % phrases.length;
        }
      }
      setTimeout(tick, deleting ? 25 : 35);
    }
    tick();
  }

  // ---- Stat counters (animate when visible) ----
  var nums = document.querySelectorAll('.sm-num-value[data-count]');
  function animateCount(el){
    var target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-count'), 10) || 0;
    var start = 0;
    var duration = 1200;
    var startTime = null;
    function frame(ts){
      if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
      var progress = Math.min((ts - startTime) / duration, 1);
      el.textContent = Math.floor(progress * (target - start) + start);
      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      else el.textContent = target;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(entry){
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCount(entry.target);
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });
    nums.forEach(function(n){ io.observe(n); });
  } else {
    nums.forEach(animateCount);
  }
})();
</script>
